input: Source biodegradable packaging for my online orders

gold.taskTitle: Source Biodegradable Packaging for Online Orders
gold.taskDescription: Find and procure suitable biodegradable packaging materials to use for fulfilling online customer orders.

questions.title: What types of products are you shipping to customers?
questions.description: Understanding the product type (fragile, liquid, apparel, food, etc.) determines what packaging formats are needed.

questions.title: What is your average monthly order volume right now?
questions.description: Order volume affects how much packaging to source and whether bulk pricing is relevant.

questions.title: What packaging formats do you currently use?
questions.description: Knowing current formats (boxes, poly mailers, bubble wrap, void fill, tape, etc.) helps identify direct biodegradable replacements.

questions.title: Do you have a budget per unit or total budget in mind?
questions.description: A defined budget will narrow supplier options and determine whether premium certified materials are feasible.

questions.title: Are there specific certifications you require, such as compostable?
questions.description: Certifications like BPI, OK Compost, or FSC may be required by the user, their customers, or local regulations.

questions.title: Do you need custom branding printed on the packaging?
questions.description: Custom printing affects supplier choice, minimum order quantities, and lead times.

questions.title: When do you need the new packaging ready to use?
questions.description: The deadline determines how urgently suppliers must be contacted and whether local or international sourcing is viable.
